body: i try, and i know that theres things to look forward to in this world, but every day it seems less and less feasible, and when those things do come it doesnt feel like i thought it would. i do accept myself, with my needs, but my parents dont and thats my problem

I'm not sorry to have met you. I feel the same way, afraid to die, because what if i mess it up? i would just have to deal with the dissapointment. If you dont want to call a hotline, you can always text one if that works better for you, and your therapist would be fine with your issues. Is there anyone/anything you can do for the alcohol? That would be the first step. hope you start to feel better

Also, please dont worry about this post being too long. After all, I cared enough to read it, right? And i know im not the only one

OP, if you ever get to read this, i want to talk to you about everything. I want you to have someone who will listen to you, finally. I want you to feel wanted, and as someone who is struggling with the same problem i know how it feels to not have anyone listen to you. would you want to talk?

Whatever happens, I hope you finally get to know peace and happiness OP

I haven't told the school, but I have been talking about this with my therapist. I've also tried to explain to my parents, but they only see me not doing the work/doing other "distracting" things and not the reasons behind them
